eventSummary:
A security breach at a cryptocurrency firm was attributed to the threat actor UNC4899. The incident occurred after a developer at the firm AirDropped a trojanized file onto a work device. This event falls under the security of cross-chain protocols and entities within the blockchain ecosystem.
Sources:
- https://www.reddit.com/r/cybersecurity/comments/1s4a7el/unc4899_breached_crypto_firm_after_developer

Venus Protocol, a decentralized lending platform on the BNB Chain, was targeted by a suspected flash loan exploit resulting in the theft of approximately $3.7 million in digital assets. This incident follows a previous security breach within the same year.
Sources:
- https://beincrypto.com/venus-protocol-defi-hack

A fake CleanMyMac website is using a 'ClickFix' attack to trick macOS users into installing SHub Stealer malware via Terminal commands. The malware is designed to steal Keychain credentials and create backdoors into cryptocurrency wallets including Exodus, Ledger, and Trezor.
Sources:
- https://bsky.app/profile/hackread.bsky.social/post/3mgnfr6pq6c2t

Google researchers have uncovered a sophisticated iOS exploit kit named 'Coruna' that includes 23 exploits targeting versions 13 through 17.2.1. The kit, which was previously used by surveillance and nation-state actors, is now being utilized by cybercriminals in phishing attacks to steal cryptocurrency from mobile wallets. The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has ordered federal agencies to patch the associated vulnerabilities.
Sources:
- https://cointelegraph.com/news/google-warns-crypto-scams-using-new-and-powerful-iphone-exploit-kit
- https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/spyware-grade-coruna-ios-exploit-kit-now-used-in-crypto-theft-attacks/
- https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/03/cisa-adds-3-ios-flaws-to-its-catalog-of-known-exploited-vulnerabilities

DeFi lending protocol Euler Finance fork on Arbitrum exploited via flash loan attack. Attacker manipulated oracle prices to drain $2.1M from USDC/WETH lending pools. Transaction traced to Tornado Cash within 30 minutes.
Sources:
- https://twitter.com/paboracle/status/example1

Cross-chain bridge Wormhole detects anomalous message validation on Solana-to-Ethereum transfers. Patch deployed within 2 hours, no funds lost. Vulnerability in Guardian signature verification could have allowed spoofed messages.
Sources:
- https://wormhole.com/security

Smart contract deployer on Base creates honeypot token SAFEMOON2, trapping $340K from 1,200+ wallets via modified transfer function that blocks sells. Contract not verified on Basescan.
Sources:
- https://basescan.org/address/example

Bybit has identified fraudulent behavior from an appeal applicant and is taking action against the account to maintain trading integrity and asset security.
Sources:
- https://t.me/bybitukrainian

Phishing campaign targeting MetaMask users via fake 'security update' emails. Estimated 500+ wallets compromised, total losses around $800K. Attack uses permit2 signature approvals to drain tokens without direct transfer approval.
Sources:
- https://twitter.com/metamask/status/example2

GRIFFIN AI is facing community criticism for failing to carry out a promised buyback as part of a compensation plan following a hack, while simultaneously withdrawing liquidity without clear explanation.
Sources:
- https://t.me/GRIFFINai

Reentrancy vulnerability discovered in popular NFT marketplace contract on Optimism. Whitehat disclosure via Immunefi, $50K bounty paid. Bug allowed attacker to claim NFT while keeping payment.
Sources:
- https://immunefi.com/bounty/example

Governance attack on small-cap DAO on Polygon. Attacker acquired 51% of governance tokens via flash loan, passed proposal to drain treasury of $1.4M in stablecoins. Timelock allowed partial mitigation — $900K recovered.
Sources:
- https://polygonscan.com/tx/example

Holdstation confirmed a security breach resulting in the theft of 462,000 USDT.
Sources:
- https://www.reddit.com/r/CryptoCurrency/comments/1re61h2/holdstation_security_breach_462000_usdt_confirmed
